blocks.text: Use Computer Management → Network & Remote → VPN Connections or WireGuard Connections to select configured connections. Connection definitions and credentials are installation/profile dependent.

Confirm the expected connection is active in the managed status view. A tunnel being up does not prove that every application uses it. Managed applications may have their own network namespaces and proxy policy.

Disconnect using the same owning utility. Record whether the failure affects all applications or one managed application. Do not flush nftables, replace default routes or move interfaces between namespaces as a diagnostic shortcut.
VPN profiles, private keys and raw connection exports can contain secrets. Never paste them into Help reports or issue logs.
